title: MARM(Music Assets and Rights Management)
tagline: Protocols that allow artists to proactively and freely define music copyright management
description: This is a music copyright management protocol that utilizes smart contracts. Instead of the complex copyright management systems of the past, the efficient and transparent process of smart contracts will allow artists to more easily and proactively manage their rights and revenues for their musical works. It also aims to be flexible enough to adapt to the latest cases of music composition by AI and the use of music in the metaverse space, which are expected to become more common in the future.
how_its_made: The front was created with react and next.js and the smart contract was deployed with Goerli in Ethreum. Use web3 modal and Wagumi for component headers. On the front, unity's webGL recognizes the user's metamask and launches the music player. It also notifies the user when he/she purchases a song using push protocol and allows the user and the owner to communicate with each other via messages.
